```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(fpp3)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

Data import/prep

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
wine_raw <- read_csv("australianwines.csv", na = c("", "NA", "*"))
wine_ts <- wine_raw |>
  mutate(
    Month = yearmonth(my(Month)),
    across(-Month, as.numeric)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-Month, names_to = "Varietal", values_to = "Sales") |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month, key = Varietal) |>
  arrange(Varietal, Month)

wine_ts |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(Varietal) |>
  summarise(missing = sum(is.na(Sales)), .groups = "drop")

wine_ts <- wine_ts |>
  group_by_key() |>
  mutate(Sales = approx(seq_along(Sales), Sales, xout = seq_along(Sales), rule = 2)$y) |>
  ungroup()

test_start <- max(wine_ts$Month) - 11
wine_train <- wine_ts |> filter(Month < test_start)
wine_test  <- wine_ts |> filter(Month >= test_start)
wine_ts
```

Data visualization

```{r}
wine_ts |>
  autoplot(Sales) +
  facet_wrap(~Varietal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "Australian Wine Sales",
       y = "Sales (thousands of litres)", x = "Month")
```

```{r}
wine_ts |>
  gg_season(Sales, labels = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~Varietal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Plot of Australian Wine Sales",
       y = "Sales (in thousands of litres)")
```

```{r}
wine_ts |>
  model(STL(Sales ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "STL Decomposition by Varietal")
```

Model fitting

```{r}
wine_fit <- wine_train |>
  model(
    SNaive = SNAIVE(Sales),
    ETS    = ETS(Sales),
    ARIMA  = ARIMA(Sales~ pdq(d = 1) + PDQ(D = 1)),
    TSLM   = TSLM(Sales ~ trend() + season())
  )

wine_fit
```

```{r}
wine_fit |>
  pivot_longer(-Varietal, names_to = "Model", values_to = "Fit") |>
  filter(Model %in% c("ETS", "ARIMA")) |>
  mutate(Specification = format(Fit)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Varietal, Model, Specification) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Specification) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Automatically Selected Model Specifications")
```

Training accuracy

```{r}
train_acc <- wine_fit |>
  accuracy() |>
  select(Varietal, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE)

train_acc |>
  arrange(Varietal, RMSE) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Varietal") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE), decimals = 2) |>
  cols_label(.model = "Model") |>
  tab_header(title = "Training Set Accuracy",
             subtitle = "Fitted values on 1980-1993 data")
```

Forecast accuracy

```{r}
wine_fc <- wine_fit |> forecast(h = 12)

test_acc <- wine_fc |>
  accuracy(wine_ts) |>
  select(Varietal, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE)

test_acc |>
  arrange(Varietal, RMSE) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Varietal") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE), decimals = 2) |>
  cols_label(.model = "Model") |>
  tab_header(title = "Test Set Accuracy",
             subtitle = "12-month holdout")
```

Forecast visualization

```{r}
wine_fc |>
  autoplot(wine_ts |> filter(year(Month) >= 1990), level = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~Varietal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "12-Month Forecasts vs. Actual Sales",
       y = "Sales (in thousands of litres)", x = "Month", colour = "Model")
```

```{r}
best_models <- test_acc |>
  group_by(Varietal) |>
  slice_min(RMSE, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Varietal, .model)

wine_fc |>
  semi_join(best_models, by = c("Varietal", ".model")) |>
  autoplot(wine_ts |> filter(year(Month) >= 1990)) +
  facet_wrap(~Varietal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "Best Model Forecast per Varietal",
       y = "Sales (in thousands of litres)", x = "Month")
```

Report generation

```{r}
best_summary <- test_acc |>
  group_by(Varietal) |>
  slice_min(RMSE, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(Varietal)

best_summary |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE), decimals = 2) |>
  cols_label(.model = "Best Model") |>
  tab_header(title = "Best Forecasting Model by Varietal",
             subtitle = "Selected by lowest test-set RMSE")
```

```{r}
model_wins <- best_summary |> count(.model, sort = TRUE)
top_model  <- model_wins$.model[1]

model_wins |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(.model = "Model", n = "Varietals won") |>
  tab_header(title = "Best Model Count",
             subtitle = "Number of varietals where each model had the lowest test RMSE") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```
